title: Manager, Business Risk and AI Automation
description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . Position Overview We're seeking a Manager, Business Risk and AI Automation, to help shape the next chapter of Internal Audit at Reddit. You'll lead day-to-day oversight and hands-on execution of our SOX program across Business Process Controls, Entity Level Controls, Key Reports, and Tech Application Controls, while helping build an AI-first approach to assurance. As part of our Risk Advisory and Assurance team, you'll tackle complex control questions and turn emerging technology into practical improvements. You’ll have opportunities to apply your expertise more broadly to strengthen internal controls and improve processes across the business. This is an opportunity for a strong internal controls practitioner who enjoys owning delivery and building better ways to work. This is an individual contributor role . The Manager owns SOX program delivery and partners with a Senior teammate who performs business process testing, providing review, technical guidance, and cross-functional coordination. What You’ll Do Own day-to-day SOX delivery from risk assessment and scoping through testing and reporting, keeping the program on track and focused on key risks. Lead walkthroughs and hands-on testing of control design and operating effectiveness across business process controls, entity level controls, key reports, and technology application controls. Ensure high-quality, well-supported SOX testing through workpaper review, actionable feedback, and technical guidance to other team members. Build trusted relationships across Finance and Accounting, Sales, People & Culture, Legal, and Technology to help control owners strengthen controls and improve processes while maintaining audit objectivity. Serve as a primary point of contact for external auditors, coordinating testing coverage, timelines, and evidence requirements to support our SOX reliance strategy. Evaluate testing exceptions, support deficiency assessment, and coordinate remediation tracking and retesting to confirm control issues are resolved. Help transform how SOX work gets done by identifying, piloting, and scaling AI and automation opportunities across evidence analysis, testing, documentation, and reporting. Build repeatable AI-enabled workflows, validate their accuracy, and help the team adopt them through clear documentation and coaching. Who You Might Be An experienced audit or risk professional with 6+ years in public accounting and/or internal audit, including leading SOX workstreams and delivering high-quality audit work. A hands-on SOX practitioner who independently drives delivery and applies sound judgment to complex control issues. A curious, practical problem-solver who connects audit work to business priorities and finds opportunities to improve established ways of working. A trusted partner who builds strong relationships with business stakeholders and external auditors, communicates findings constructively, and works through complex control judgments. Experience at a platform company preferred. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Professional certifications such as CPA, CIA, and/or CISA preferred. Strong knowledge of SOX and COSO, including risk-based scoping, walkthroughs, control design and operating effectiveness testing, evidence evaluation, and deficiency assessment. Strong project management, workpaper review, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex processes and risks into clear conclusions and practical recommendations. Hands-on experience using AI tools and prompting to improve professional workflows, with the ability to test, refine, and critically evaluate results. Experience with agentic AI, data analytics, or low-code automation is a plus. Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ . To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. title: Associate Manager, SOX and Internal Controls
description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  Learn more about working at Coinbase . About the team The Finance Controls team helps management establish and maintain effective internal controls over financial reporting. We partner closely with control owners, Finance and Accounting leaders, Internal Audit, external auditors, Technology and Security teams, Legal, Compliance, and other cross-functional partners to strengthen the control environment and support reliable financial reporting. As an Associate Manager, SOX & Internal Controls, you'll own a defined set of business processes within Coinbase's SOX and SOC 1 programs from end to end. Our Internal Controls team keeps Coinbase audit-ready by designing, documenting, and monitoring the controls that safeguard financial reporting across a fast-changing crypto platform. You'll bring a technology lens to controls work, mapping data flows from source systems to financial statements, evaluating automated control evidence, and driving remediation when gaps arise. What you'll do: Own assigned SOX business processes end to end, including process narratives, risk-and-control matrices, key systems, automated controls, and business process controls, keeping each area audit-ready through continuous documentation and design updates. Partner with Technology, Engineering, Security Compliance, and Finance Analytics to scope IT general controls and IT application controls, map data flows, and evaluate the reliability of system-generated evidence. Lead day-to-day SOX and SOC 1 execution for your area, including risk assessment, scoping, walkthroughs, testing coordination, deficiency evaluation, and remediation tracking with control owners. Coordinate audit readiness and information requests with Internal Audit and external auditors, ensuring support is timely, complete, and well organized. Advise control owners on control design, evidence quality, and sustainable remediation while helping improve repeatable standards, playbooks, and evidence workflows across the function. Required Skills and Experience: 6+ years in SOX, IT audit, internal controls, controllership, or a closely related controls function, with Big Four or public accounting experience preferred. Demonstrated ownership of a business process or controls workstream end to end, from documentation through testing and remediation, in a heavily automated, high-change environment. Working knowledge of ITGCs (access, change management, operations), IT application controls, and system-generated reports, with the ability to trace how a system supports a financial process. Hands-on experience with data validation across systems using SQL, spreadsheets, or analytics tools to test control logic and verify system output. CPA, CISA, CIA, or comparable certification preferred; Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)).    Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus): $130,900 — $154,000 USD Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. title: Principal Security GRC Analyst
description: Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.  At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.  A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. About the role: As a member of the Roblox Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team, you will play a key role in supporting the Security team’s mission. The GRC team is at the heart of Roblox's security organization — empowering every builder to make risk-informed decisions by establishing a portfolio of governing policies and standards, a repeatable and scalable method of assessing and quantifying risk, and a formal oversight process for GRC capabilities across Roblox. Our program takes a balanced, "right-sized" approach to security governance — combining qualitative and quantitative risk management methodologies, including Factor Analysis of Information Risk (FAIR), to assess and prioritize the security risks that matter most to Roblox. GRC partners closely with Engineering, Legal, Finance, and leadership — including providing regular reporting to the Board of Directors and the Audit & Compliance Committee — to ensure that security risk is visible, well-understood, and actioned appropriately. The team is in an exciting phase of growth and innovation. We are using engineering to drive automation across risk management, policy lifecycle management, supply chain risk, AI risk, and controls programs. You will have the opportunity to shape how GRC operates at scale and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing team culture that supports Roblox and the broader security organization. This position is part of the Information Security team. This role will report to the GRC Manager. You will: You will lead one or more program areas in our Governance, Risk, and Compliance team You will be a key contributor to the larger Information Security Organization. You will partner with your GRC, Infosec and Engineering colleagues and support the design and implementation of a “risk first”  governance function that is “right-sized” for Roblox. You will identify opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness, designing tools and automations along the way to drive security and compliance by design. You will write, revise, and manage our information security policies, standards, and procedures. You will identify and assess information security risks. You will work with Information Security and Engineering colleagues to implement appropriate controls to mitigate identified risks. You will validate control design and effectiveness. You will support ongoing risk monitoring and reporting. You will be a subject matter expert in the GRC space, providing education and guidance to others across the Roblox organization. You will be a part of the Roblox community, living our values and securing the metaverse. You have: 10+ years of relevant professional experience in Security Governance, Risk and Compliance. Experience interfacing with software engineers to identify risks, map commitments to controls and develop relevant policies.  Experience assessing adherence to policies and developing mitigation and remediation plans when gaps exist. Deep understanding of risk assessment, compliance frameworks, creation of policy, and how to educate organizations on these concepts.      Understanding of security concepts and a broad range of security risks and controls. Experience in tech; however the need to actively code is not required for the role, just the ability to interface with Engineers and quickly establish credibility.  For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page . Annual Salary Range $288,020 — $335,580 USD Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
